decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The finials to the railings shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

Condition : 4 - Full details of the planting/treatment on the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
description: Erection of new boundary wall and fence to dwellinghouse
